findings.highlight: I'm sure something akin to that Servant's weakness would come up
findings.evidenceJa: あのサーヴァントの弱点らしきものが浮かび上がってくるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: かもしれない leaves open whether recollecting the War will reveal anything resembling Gilgamesh's weakness.
findings.explanation: A possible weakness emerging from review becomes a certainty.

findings.highlight: I for sure thought I would've overslept. I feel embarassed just thinking how Tohsaka would violently wake me up and give me a scolding.
findings.evidenceJa: うっかり寝過ごし、遠坂にたたき起こされでもしたら一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ
findings.governingReading: Had he carelessly slept too long and been shaken awake by Rin, he would never have been able to hold his head up before her again.
findings.explanation: A counterfactual lifelong loss of face becomes a belief that he had overslept plus an imagined violent scolding.

findings.highlight: I jumped up thinking my heart was about to burst out.
findings.evidenceJa: 飛び出しそうな心臓を押さえて立ち上がる
findings.governingReading: He restrains or presses the heart that feels about to leap out, then gets to his feet.
findings.explanation: Shirou holding down his pounding heart before standing becomes jumping up while thinking it might burst.

findings.highlight: as I'm trying to clean myself up.
findings.evidenceJa: あたふたと身なりを整えながら
findings.governingReading: 身なりを整える means hurriedly putting his clothes/appearance in order after the nap.
findings.explanation: Straightening his disordered appearance becomes cleaning himself.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka didn't realize I dozed off for a bit
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は俺の寝ぼけぶりにも気がつかず
findings.governingReading: 寝ぼけぶり is the observable degree or manner of his sleep-addled state as he answers her.
findings.explanation: Rin failing to notice Shirou's groggy behavior becomes ignorance that he slept.

findings.highlight: "No, I don't! ...Ugh, will you just sit down already!?
findings.evidenceJa: ないわよっ！　……ああもう、いいから座って！
findings.governingReading: The command to sit ends before her next complete sentence.
findings.explanation: Rin's first spoken sentence lacks a closing quotation mark.

findings.highlight: Then she slowly moves back into the room.
findings.governingReading: ずかずか marks her bold or stomping return after locking the door.
findings.explanation: Rin's forceful stride again becomes slow movement.

findings.highlight: I sit down across from her.
findings.evidenceJa: クッションに腰を下ろす
findings.governingReading: He sits on a cushion in response to Rin sitting in the chair.
findings.explanation: Shirou's cushion is again omitted and replaced with an across-from relation.

findings.highlight: And somehow we're both not saying a word, this feels awkward...
findings.evidenceJa: そうして、なんとなく落ち着かない沈黙
findings.governingReading: An awkward or unsettled silence follows.
findings.explanation: The uneasy silence is rendered as a comma splice.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーには優しいのよね、衛宮くんは
findings.governingReading: Her barbed line explicitly shifts to 衛宮くん.
findings.explanation: Rin's pointed Emiya-kun address is again omitted.
